edition.authority: Second Vatican Council; Pope Paul VI
edition.notes: The official Latin Acta constituent contains numbered articles 1-22 and the promulgation formula on printed pp. 991-1024. Rather than reprinting the subscription list, p. 1024 refers to the common subscriptions on pp. 941-946.
edition.title: Decretum de presbyterorum ministerio et vita Presbyterorum ordinis

passages.context: The Decree's complete numbered Latin body, beginning with article 1 on printed p. 991 and ending with article 22 on printed p. 1024 immediately before the promulgation formula.
passages.notes: The beginning, numbered sequence, article-22 endpoint, and transition to promulgation were checked against the exact Acta artifact; no complete diplomatic transcription or word-for-word image collation is claimed.

passages.context: The complete official Latin article was inspected on printed pp. 1011-1013 for Eucharistic sacrifice in priestly holiness, including « opus nostrae redemptionis continuo exercetur »; its chapter-local note 14 on p. 1012 identifies the Roman Missal prayer over the offerings for the Ninth Sunday after Pentecost.
passages.notes: The article reuses the Secret's clause with continuo inserted; it does not reproduce the liturgical wording verbatim. The Acta apparatus numbers the source note 14, whereas the consolidated Latin web apparatus numbers the equivalent note 105. This source-of-source attribution does not replace direct collation of the liturgical witness or make every consumer of this passage a consumer of the complete Missal.

work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Decree on the Ministry and Life of Priests, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 7 December 1965. It comprises numbered articles 1-22; edition records distinguish the Latin Acta witness from dated Vatican web delivery states and translations.
